description: Hobby+ endpoint. Order-book depth history for one event on the exchanges (kalshi, polymarket, polymarket_us, prophetx): every recorded change of an outcome's best price, takeable size (liquidity, dollars) and the levels beyond it (depth: [{price, size}], best first). Use it to backtest with the size that was really there. Recorded from 2026-11-10. Paged: when next_from is set, call again with from=next_from. Free tier returns redacted structure.

bookmakers.description: Comma-separated subset of kalshi, polymarket, polymarket_us, prophetx. Default all four.

from.description: ISO timestamp; states at or after. Pass next_from here to page.

interval.description: Keep the last state per outcome per bucket.

period.description: Game-period filter; omitted = full game, 'all' = every period.

to.description: ISO timestamp; states at or before.

name: propline_get_depth_history
title: Get order-book depth history
